spec.description:
Request an authentication token for connecting to and authenticating with Kraken's private WebSocket API. The token should be used within 15 minutes of issuance; once a successful connection and private subscription has been made, it does not expire for the life of that connection.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `WebSocket interface - On`

response.title: WebSocketsTokenFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

result.title: WebSocketsToken
result.description: A short-lived token authenticating a private WebSocket connection.

expires.description: Seconds after which the token expires (~900), unless already consumed by a private WebSocket subscription.

notes: Upstream's request body declares only `nonce`, which is transport-injected by the client core (authed_request) rather than a caller-supplied parameter -- so once dropped there is nothing left to describe, and `requestBody` is omitted entirely rather than declared as an empty object.
